limitations: Two new head/sampler seeds plus the adopted exploratory seed; initial core strengths are not independently randomized.
Fixed 32k-exposure horizon. No checkpoint selection, final-test evaluation, matches or TPU use.
Reduced-source novelty precedes retinal rendering; FP32 rendering collisions are not certified absent.
Motor perturbations hold context fixed and can be out of distribution. No action groups were fitted.
Raw motor response concentration describes these models and probes, not physiological recordings.
Counted inference uses the original unpruned runtime and excludes backward/optimizer/memory work and search. No new equi-FLOP CNN comparison is established.

novelty.scope: Exact D4-canonical reduced source inputs before rendering. Neutral keys describe actual constant-vision inputs; current keys do not certify absence of FP32 retinal collisions. No labels or final-test examples inspected.

plan.name: attachment-confirmation-v1
plan.scope: Paired learner/sampler seeds 2 and 3 at the seed-1 screen's fixed 32k horizon. Same geometry, context, port seed, equations, optimizer and validation. No checkpoint selection, final-test evaluation or TPU use. Qualify each actual seed before launch. Seed 1 is an adopted exploratory reference; report the two new seeds separately and pooled with it.

summary_scope: Compact publication. Complete learning curves, diagnostics and per-batch arithmetic remain in the hashed full report; aligned position/motor arrays remain in their study directories.
uncertainty: 1000 paired opening-family bootstrap resamples of per-position metrics averaged across the named fitted seeds. Intervals condition on those weights; they do not estimate training-seed uncertainty. Per-seed means and sample SD are separate.
